articles.summary: Benzinga: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi Says Companies Are 'Play-Acting' With AI — Even As 90% Plan To Spend More — The Real Work Means 'Breaking Down The Rules'. A growing divide is forming between companies talking about artificial intelligence and those changing how they work. "Play-acting" is how many businesses approach AI, Uber Technologies Inc. (NYSE:UBER) CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said last month at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, even as most companies plan to increase spending on the technology.
